# stalwart_spam_rule_any (Resource)

Defines a spam filter rule for message classification. Manages the Any variant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `condition` (Attributes) Expression that returns the tag to assign to the message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition))
- `name` (String) Short name for the rule

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the rule
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether to enable this rule
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the rule

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--condition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `condition`

Optional:

- `else` (String) Else condition
- `match` (Attributes List) List of conditions and their corresponding results (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--condition--match))

### Nested Schema for `condition.match`

Optional:

- `if` (String) If condition
- `then` (String) Then clause
